name: dawn-lang
description: Language support for Dawn: diagnostics, hover, go to definition, outline, semantic highlighting.

scripts.test: node test/scope-contract.js && node test/semantic-contract.js && node test/server-contract.js && node test/source-contract.js

semanticTokenModifiers.description: A `var` binding or a handler state cell, where it is declared and wherever it is used.

dawn.lspPath.description: Path to the dawn CLI (the language server runs as `dawn lsp`). A bare name is looked up on PATH; `~`, `${userHome}` and `${workspaceFolder}` are expanded, and a relative path is taken from the first workspace folder. Changing it restarts the server.

dawn.inlayHints.propagatedErrors.description: Show the error type a `?` propagates, after the `?` (`parse(s)? ⇡ ParseError`). Only on a `Result`; an `Option` has no error to show. Changing it restarts the server, which reads inlay hint options only at startup.

dawn.inlayHints.declarationEffects.description: Show the `!io` the checker infers for a private function that omits both its return type and its effects, after the parameter list. A pure function gets no hint. Changing it restarts the server, which reads inlay hint options only at startup.

dawn.inlayHints.patternTypes.description: Show the types of the names a `for` pattern or a `match` arm binds (`for (k, v) in ...`, `Some(v) ->`). Separate from the hints on `let`, so loop variables can be quieted without losing those. Changing it restarts the server, which reads inlay hint options only at startup.
